turns.assessment: The causal event is a common approximately 6 dB power loss introduced before the S05→S09 booster: amp0 input is already low, and the same loss propagates through every amplifier and all monitored channels. Stable pump currents and unchanged amplifier gains argue against an amplifier fault, while the residual signal rules out a pulled connector. The location and recent S05 maintenance strongly identify contamination of the OMS input connector; the later S01→S15 pump-current excursion is unrelated.

proposals.rationale: A dirty connector on the patch between the S05 ROADM degree and the S05→S09 booster would lower every channel before amp0. This exactly matches the nearly identical 6 dB reductions at amp0 input/output, all downstream amplifiers, and all three S09 channel measurements. Maintenance at S05 provides additional support.
